title_zh: iPhone 国行 AI 官宣，11 月 4 日开放测试
content_zh:
苹果宣布，首批 Apple 智能功能将于 11 月 4 日随 iOS 开发者 Beta 版在中国开放测试，并于 12 月随 iOS 27.3 正式推出。苹果与阿里巴巴合作，在 Siri、写作工具和视觉智能的部分体验中接入千问，支持文本与图像理解。

首批功能包括信息、FaceTime 和电话中的实时翻译，写作工具的改写、校对与摘要，照片消除、自然语言搜索及回忆影片创建，以及智绘表情、通知摘要和优先邮件等。用户登录千问账户或使用「通过 Apple 登录」后，可在系统内调用千问；写作工具中的「创作」功能也可借助千问生成内容。

支持设备包括 iPhone 15 Pro、iPhone 15 Pro Max、iPhone 16 及后续机型、iPhone Duo 和 iPhone Air。此次更新不包含 Siri AI 及苹果在 WWDC 2026 上公布的其他下一代 Apple 智能功能，其他平台需获得必要审批后推出。

面对面对话翻译需配合安装最新固件的 AirPods 5、AirPods 4 主动降噪款、AirPods Pro 2 及后续机型，或 AirPods Max 2 使用。

🔗 相关阅读：突发！iPhone 国行 AI 真的来了，千问成为 Siri 新搭档
title_en: Apple Intelligence Set for China Launch in November with Alibaba's Qwen Integration
content_en:
Apple has officially announced the launch timeline for Apple Intelligence in Mainland China. The initial suite of features will enter developer beta testing on November 4, followed by a public rollout alongside iOS 27.3 in December. To power key experiences such as Siri, Writing Tools, and Visual Intelligence, Apple has partnered with Alibaba to integrate its Qwen Large Language Model for text and image understanding.

The upcoming release brings a broad range of AI-powered features, including real-time translation across Messages, FaceTime, and Phone calls. Users can also expect Writing Tools for rewriting, proofreading, and summarizing, as well as advanced Photos capabilities like object removal, natural language search, and memory video creation. Additional tools include Genmoji, notification summaries, and priority email. To access Qwen-powered generation in Writing Tools and system-wide functions, users can log in via their Qwen account or "Sign in with Apple."

The feature set will be compatible with the iPhone 15 Pro series, iPhone 16 models and later, alongside the iPhone Duo and iPhone Air. However, this release excludes next-generation Siri AI capabilities announced at WWDC 2026, which remain subject to regulatory approvals. Additionally, face-to-face conversation translation will require supported AirPods running the latest firmware.

title_zh: DeepSeek 千亿融资曝光，腾讯、宁德时代、长鑫等参投
content_zh:
据 The Information 报道，DeepSeek 本月完成了约 1055 亿元人民币（约 158 亿美元）的第二轮融资，来自近 30 家投资者，投后估值为 6155 亿元人民币。

报道称，腾讯和宁德时代仍是 DeepSeek 的前两大投资者。本轮新加入的投资方包括长鑫存储及其董事长朱一明，以及中芯国际。vivo、美团、美的、立讯精密、吉利、携程和小红书也参与其中，单家出资规模在 10 亿至 30 亿元人民币之间。

国有电信运营商中国移动、中国电信，投行中金公司、中信证券，以及保险公司中国人寿，出资规模在 20 亿至 80 亿元人民币之间。国家人工智能产业发展基金再次出资 10 亿元人民币，与首轮相同，且是直接投资 DeepSeek。

DeepSeek 在约 6 个月内累计融资 1365 亿元人民币，梁文锋另外向公司投入 20 亿元人民币。
title_en: DeepSeek Secures Massive $15.8B Funding Round, Boosting Valuation to $92B
content_en:
Chinese AI startup DeepSeek has completed a massive Series B funding round of approximately 105.5 billion RMB ($15.8 billion USD) from nearly 30 investors, according to a report by *The Information*. The latest injection propels the company's post-money valuation to an impressive 615.5 billion RMB (around $92 billion USD).

Tech giant Tencent and battery leader CATL retain their positions as DeepSeek's top two investors. The round also welcomed semiconductor heavyweights such as ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT), led by Chairman Zhu Yiming, and SMIC. A diverse roster of corporate giants—including vivo, Meituan, Midea, Luxshare Precision, Geely, Trip.com, and Xiaohongshu—contributed between 1 billion and 3 billion RMB each.

State-backed entities and financial institutions also turned out in force. State telecom operators China Mobile and China Telecom, alongside investment firms CICC, CITIC Securities, and China Life Insurance, invested between 2 billion and 8 billion RMB each. Meanwhile, China's National AI Industry Development Fund injected another 1 billion RMB in direct investment, matching its first-round contribution. In total, DeepSeek has raised 136.5 billion RMB over the past six months, with founder Liang Wenfeng personally contributing an additional 2 billion RMB.

title_zh: 特斯拉推出 5 年零息方案，Model 3 / Y 首付 3.99 万元起
content_zh:
特斯拉在中国推出新一轮 5 年零息购车金融方案，活动时间为 10 月 30 日至 11 月 30 日（含）。据界面新闻，Model 3 和 Model Y 的后轮驱动版、长续航后轮驱动版及长续航全轮驱动版可参加，首付均为 3.99 万元起。

本轮方案采用「首付 + 月付 + 期末尾款」的结构。Model 3 尾款立减 1 万元后，五年月供最高约 2429 元；Model Y 尾款立减 4000 元后，五年月供最高约 2995 元。两者在分期结束时均另有 3.99 万元尾款。

Model Y L 首付为 5.99 万元起，五年月供最高约 3920 元，期末尾款同为 3.99 万元。特斯拉中国 Model 3 订购页也列出了限时 5 年零息和指定版本尾款立减权益。
title_en: Tesla Rolls Out Five-Year Zero-Interest Financing Plan in China
content_en:
Tesla has launched a new promotional financing campaign in China, offering five-year zero-interest loans from October 30 through November 30. According to *Jiemian News*, the promotion covers Rear-Wheel Drive, Long-Range Rear-Wheel Drive, and Long-Range All-Wheel Drive variants of the Model 3 and Model Y, with down payments starting at 39,900 RMB.

The financing scheme features a structured breakdown consisting of an initial down payment, monthly installments, and a final balloon payment. Under the offer, buyers receive discounts on the final balloon payment—10,000 RMB off for the Model 3 and 4,000 RMB off for the Model Y. Maximum monthly payments are capped at approximately 2,429 RMB for the Model 3 and 2,995 RMB for the Model Y, with both models requiring a remaining balloon payment of 39,900 RMB at the end of the term.

Additionally, the Model Y L is available with a down payment starting at 59,900 RMB, a maximum monthly payment of around 3,920 RMB, and the same final 39,900 RMB balloon payment. Details of the limited-time zero-interest financing and target model discounts have also been officially updated on Tesla China's Model 3 order page.

title_zh: 于东来建议支持「消费入座」，餐厅可拒绝外带食物就餐
content_zh:
胖东来创始人于东来发文，建议以制度支持「消费入座」，保护商家及消费顾客的利益，并支持餐厅拒绝顾客携带外带食物就餐。

据界面新闻报道，他将这项建议与培养商业秩序、商业环境及消费习惯联系在一起，同时提到个人的品格修养。

他写道：「培养文明美好的商业秩序和商业环境、良好的消费习惯和推动个人的品格修养！」发文将餐厅入座及外带食物问题，放在商家、在店消费顾客双方利益的讨论中。
title_en: Pangdonglai Founder Advocates "Pay-to-Sit" Policy and Outside Food Bans in Restaurants
content_en:
Yu Donglai, founder of retail giant Pangdonglai, has called for formal policy support to enforce a "pay-to-sit" rule in dining establishments, advocating that businesses should have the right to refuse patrons who bring outside food.

According to Jiemian News, Yu framed his proposal around fostering better commercial order, healthy consumer habits, and personal etiquette. He emphasized that establishing clear regulations protects the mutual interests of both restaurant owners and paying customers, ultimately contributing to a more civilized business environment.

title_zh: 开发者在 Surface Duo 2 上启动 iOS 27 iPhone Duo 版本
content_zh:
开发者 SmuOS 展示了在微软 Surface Duo 2 上运行 iOS 27 的最新进展。这次使用的是 iPhone Duo 版本，系统桌面可以识别折叠设备的内外屏布局。

据其原帖，iOS 27 通过显示类型 31 与 32 区分外屏和展开状态。SpringBoard 检测到这两种类型后，才会启用 Duo 专属桌面布局。开发者还展示了界面缩放过大的画面，显示适配仍在调整。
title_en: Developer Successfully Boots Customized iOS Build on Microsoft Surface Duo 2
content_en:
Independent developer SmuOS recently showcased progress in running a custom "iPhone Duo" build of iOS on Microsoft's dual-screen Surface Duo 2. The system desktop can now successfully detect and differentiate between the device's outer cover screen and its unfolded inner dual-display layout.

Technical details reveal that the system's SpringBoard interface enables a dedicated Duo desktop layout upon identifying specific display state flags. While the milestone demonstrates significant progress in cross-platform porting, the developer noted that interface scaling and UI adaptations are still being actively refined.

title_zh: REDMI 回应 K100 选用旧旗舰芯：性能表现胜任游戏
content_zh: REDMI 发布 K100、REDMI Book 2027 与 REDMI Clip Neo 的答网友问，回应新产品的芯片、散热及麦克风设计。
title_en: REDMI Defends Older Flagship Chipset in New K100 Smartphone
content_en:
In a recent community Q&A session covering the REDMI K100, REDMI Book 2027, and REDMI Clip Neo, the brand addressed user concerns regarding the K100's use of a previous-generation flagship processor.

REDMI reassured consumers that despite utilizing an older flagship chip, the K100 delivers robust performance fully capable of handling demanding gaming workloads. The Q&A also clarified design details regarding thermal dissipation and microphone configurations across the new product line.

title_zh: 张雪称拉黑母亲微信，反对机构把家人当作流量入口
content_zh:
张雪机车创始人张雪发布视频称，自己已拉黑母亲的微信。他表示，夺冠后母亲频繁接受拍摄和采访，自己曾多次要求停止。

张雪反对机构及个人把家人当作流量入口，并表示：「所有想以我妈为流量入口的机构或者人，我都鄙视你。」

张雪在视频文案中还写道：「所有消耗我的人或事，我会毫不犹豫地砍掉，不管你是谁。」
title_en: Zhang Xue Blocks Mother on WeChat to Protest Media Exploitation of Family
content_en:
Zhang Xue, founder of Zhang Xue Motorcycle, revealed in a recent video that he has blocked his mother on WeChat after she repeatedly accepted media interviews and filming requests following his championship victory, despite his repeated requests for her to stop.

Zhang voiced strong opposition against organizations and individuals exploiting his family for social media traffic, stating he has complete contempt for anyone seeking clout through his mother. He added that he will unequivocally cut off any person or situation that drains his energy, regardless of who they are.

title_zh: OpenAI 重构模型规范，将「忠于人类意图」列为首项准则
content_zh:
近日，OpenAI 更新 Model Spec，以五项价值重新组织模型行为原则：忠于人类意图、减少伤害、诚实透明、保障人的自主选择，以及审慎关怀。规范面向驱动 ChatGPT 和 API 等产品的 GPT 模型，公开说明公司希望如何塑造模型行为。

新版把用户和开发者想完成什么放在核心位置，同时保留指令层级与安全边界。对于目标尚不明确的任务，模型应结合上下文理解意图；对事实、证据、不确定性、能力和实际采取的行动，则应如实说明，让人能够评估其工作。

规范还专门讨论了即时指令与长期目标之间的张力：模型可以提示被忽略的后果、帮助用户思考，但不能把自己预测用户将来会作出的选择，视为用户已经作出的决定。OpenAI 表示，线上模型尚未完全达到规范要求，公司将继续调整训练与系统。
title_en: OpenAI Refreshes Model Spec, Making 'Fidelity to Human Intent' Top Priority
content_en:
OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, reorganizing its AI behavior principles around five core values: fidelity to human intent, reducing harm, honesty and transparency, safeguarding human autonomy, and prudent care. Designed for the GPT models powering ChatGPT and API products, the public framework details how OpenAI aims to shape model behavior.

The revised specification places user and developer goals at its core while maintaining safety boundaries and instruction hierarchies. For tasks with ambiguous objectives, models are directed to infer intent using context. They must also remain transparent about facts, uncertainties, capabilities, and executed actions so users can accurately evaluate their output.

Additionally, the specification addresses the balance between immediate prompts and long-term goals. While models may highlight overlooked consequences to assist user decision-making, they are prohibited from treating predicted future choices as finalized decisions. OpenAI acknowledged that its live models do not yet fully meet these standards, and ongoing adjustments will be made to training and system architectures.

title_zh: 米哈游《星布谷地》定档 12 月 4 日公测
content_zh:
米哈游旗下生活模拟游戏《星布谷地》宣布，公测将于 12 月 4 日开启，官方同步发布定档宣传片，11 月 1 日 19:00 将举办公测前瞻特别节目。

玩家在游戏中扮演「种星人」，经营一颗自己的星球：改造地形、规划区域，采集资源并制作家具；也可以与动物邻居一起采摘、冒险和建房。向外探索时，玩家可驾船前往不同地貌和生态的星屿，寻找资源，并在星空街市与其他玩家相遇。

据巴哈姆特 GNN 报道，游戏将于 12 月 1 日开放预下载，登陆 PC、iOS 和 Android。官网已开放预约，完成预约可获得「星空贴贴手灯」，全球预约里程碑还将解锁「小星苗」套装等奖励。
title_en: HoYoverse Sets December 4 Open Beta for Life-Sim Game 'Starry Sky Valley'
content_en:
HoYoverse has announced that its new life simulation game, *Starry Sky Valley*, will officially enter open beta on December 4. Alongside the release date reveal, the developer published a promotional trailer and scheduled a special preview broadcast for November 1.

In the game, players assume the role of "Star Planters" to build and manage their own custom planet. Gameplay encompasses terraforming, zone planning, resource gathering, furniture crafting, and settling down alongside animal neighbors. Players can also set sail to explore diverse island ecosystems and interact with others in a shared star market.

Pre-downloads will open on December 1 across PC, iOS, and Android platforms. Pre-registration is now live on the official website, offering exclusive rewards such as a decorative hand lantern and global milestone outfit bundles.

title_zh: 大众 CFO：电动车热销也带来利润压力，须加快降本
content_zh:
大众集团 CFO 兼 COO Arno Antlitz 在前三季度业绩声明中表示，电动车在欧洲的订单占比达到 40%，但现阶段电动车利润低于燃油车，销量增长也给盈利带来额外压力。

他同时提到美国关税、中国市场收缩和欧洲竞争加剧。大众前三季度剔除特殊项目后的营业销售回报率为 3.8%，他认为这一水平不足以支撑未来的大规模投入。

Antlitz 提出的应对措施包括精简车型、简化组织、降低车辆及管理成本、提高工厂效率，并加快技术开发。他要求迅速、一致地执行这些措施。
title_en: Volkswagen CFO Urges Faster Cost Cuts as Rising EV Sales Weigh on Profits
content_en:
Volkswagen Group CFO and COO Arno Antlitz warned that strong demand for electric vehicles is putting pressure on profitability, as EV margins currently lag behind traditional combustion-engine cars. EV orders accounted for 40% of the group's total in Europe over the first three quarters.

Compounding the margin squeeze are external challenges, including U.S. tariffs, a shrinking market share in China, and fierce competition in Europe. Volkswagen reported a 3.8% operating return on sales (excluding special items) for the first nine months—a level Antlitz deemed insufficient to fund necessary future investments.

To address these headwinds, Antlitz called for swift and decisive action. Proposed measures include streamlining vehicle lineups, simplifying organizational structures, reducing manufacturing and administrative costs, boosting factory efficiency, and accelerating technological development.

title_zh: OPPO 调整高管分工：李炳忠统管海外，尹文广负责全系手机
content_zh:
据界面新闻 10 月 30 日报道，OPPO 发布高管任命与分工调整通知：高级副总裁李炳忠全面负责海外业务，对 OPPO 及子系列在海外市场的经营结果负责；副总裁尹文广负责所有手机产品系列，向首席产品官刘作虎汇报。

李炳忠是 OPPO 早期出海开拓者之一，曾参与一线市场、本土化运营和全球品牌业务；尹文广长期负责产品规划。刘作虎则统筹手机与生态产品的协同体验、技术创新及新品类开拓。
title_en: OPPO Reshuffles Executive Leadership to Streamline Global Business and Product Lines
content_en:
Chinese smartphone maker OPPO has announced major executive leadership adjustments, according to a report by Jiemian News on October 30. Senior Vice President Sky Li (Li Bingzhong) has been appointed to oversee all overseas operations, taking full responsibility for the performance of OPPO and its sub-brands in international markets.

Meanwhile, Vice President Yin Wenguang will take charge of all smartphone product lines, reporting directly to Chief Product Officer Pete Lau (Liu Zuohu).

Sky Li was an early pioneer in OPPO's overseas expansion, bringing deep expertise in localized operations and global branding. Under the new setup, Pete Lau will focus on driving tech innovation, expanding into new product categories, and creating seamless synergy between smartphones and ecosystem devices.

title_zh: 亚马逊 CEO：2027 年资本开支将明显高于今年的 2200 亿美元
content_zh:
亚马逊 CEO Andy Jassy 在第三季度财报电话会上表示，公司仍计划在 2026 年投入 2200 亿美元资本开支，2027 年的支出将「明显更多」。

据 Business Insider 原始报道，亚马逊第三季度现金资本开支为 759 亿美元，主要投向 AWS 与 AI 基础设施；过去 12 个月自由现金流为负 424 亿美元。

Jassy 表示，大型客户会提前预订数百兆瓦、甚至吉瓦级的算力容量，公司因此能看到 2027 年、2028 年乃至部分 2029 年的需求。他预计 AWS 在 2027 年和 2028 年的收入增速均可超过 40%。
title_en: Amazon CEO Signals Higher Capex Beyond 2026 Driven by Surging AI and Cloud Demand
content_en:
Amazon CEO Andy Jassy stated during the company's Q3 earnings call that capital expenditures in 2027 will be "meaningfully higher" than the $220 billion planned for 2026. The aggressive spending underscores Amazon's commitment to expanding infrastructure for AWS and generative AI.

According to Business Insider, Amazon's cash capex reached $75.9 billion in the third quarter, primarily funneled into AWS and AI infrastructure, bringing its trailing 12-month free cash flow to negative $42.4 billion.

Jassy explained that major enterprise clients are reserving compute capacity—ranging from hundreds of megawatts to gigawatts—well in advance, giving the company clear visibility into demand through 2029. He expects AWS revenue growth to top 40% in both 2027 and 2028.

title_zh: Reddit CEO：Google AI Mode 没给网站带来流量
content_zh:
Reddit CEO Steve Huffman 在第三季度财报电话会上表示，Google 的 AI Mode 没有给 Reddit 带来流量；据他所知，其他网站也没有从中受益。

据 The Verge 原始报道，Reddit 在 10 月来自 Google 的平均每周引荐流量减少超过 100 万。Huffman 认为，AI Overview 和 AI Mode 将外部链接推到更靠下的位置，部分美国以外市场的机器翻译内容排名也有所下降。

他同时表示，用户对 Reddit 的搜索需求仍然存在，Google 抓取 Reddit 的活动没有出现相应下降。
title_en: Reddit CEO Says Google’s AI Features Fail to Drive Traffic to External Sites
content_en:
Reddit CEO Steve Huffman revealed during the company's Q3 earnings call that Google's AI Mode and AI Overviews have failed to generate referral traffic for Reddit, adding that other publisher websites appear to be facing the same issue.

According to reports by The Verge, Reddit lost over one million weekly referral visits from Google in October alone. Huffman attributed the decline to Google's AI features pushing external links further down search results pages, alongside ranking drops for machine-translated content in international markets.

Despite the slump in search referrals, Huffman noted that user demand for Reddit content remains robust and Google's scraping activity on the platform has shown no signs of slowing down.

title_zh: 奇瑞前三季度营收 2412.34 亿元，归母净利润下滑
content_zh:
奇瑞汽车公布截至 9 月底的未经审计业绩，前三季度收入为 2412.34 亿元，上年同期为 2148.33 亿元；归母净利润为 139.63 亿元，上年同期为 143.65 亿元。

期内毛利润由 294.64 亿元增至 390.04 亿元。研发费用由 78.78 亿元增至 110.46 亿元，销售与行政费用也有所增加。

汇率变化影响了其他收支：本期录得汇兑净损失 31.71 亿元，上年同期则有汇兑净收益 29.74 亿元。
title_en: Chery Posts 241 Billion Yuan Nine-Month Revenue as Rising R&D and Forex Losses Drag Profit
content_en:
Chery Automobile released its unaudited financial results for the first three quarters of the year, reporting revenue of 241.23 billion yuan, up from 214.83 billion yuan during the same period last year. However, net profit attributable to the parent company slipped slightly to 13.96 billion yuan from 14.37 billion yuan.

While gross profit grew strongly from 29.46 billion yuan to 39.00 billion yuan, higher operating costs squeezed bottom-line margins. Research and development expenses rose sharply to 11.05 billion yuan from 7.88 billion yuan, alongside increased sales and administrative expenses.

Foreign exchange fluctuations also impacted profitability. Chery recorded a net foreign exchange loss of 3.17 billion yuan for the period, reversing a net exchange gain of 2.97 billion yuan reported in the previous year.

title_zh: 传音第三季度营收下降 27.45%，前三季度归母净利润仍增长
content_zh:
传音控股披露第三季度报告：第三季度营业收入为 148.49 亿元，同比下降 27.45%；归母净利润为 8.57 亿元，同比下降 8.40%；扣非归母净利润为 4.36 亿元，同比下降 47.72%。

拉长至前三季度，收入为 502.80 亿元，同比增长 1.49%；归母净利润为 26.30 亿元，同比增长 22.44%。公司在报告中将第三季度扣非利润下降与供应链成本上升、市场容量变化带来的收入减少联系起来。

前三季度经营活动现金流净流出 98.73 亿元。公司称，存储价格上升、备货增加及采购支付增长影响了现金流。
title_en: Transsion Q3 Revenue Slumps 27% Amid Cost Pressures, But 9-Month Profit Remains Up
content_en:
Chinese smartphone maker Transsion Holdings reported a 27.45% year-on-year drop in third-quarter revenue to 14.85 billion yuan. Net profit attributable to the parent company fell 8.40% to 857 million yuan, while non-GAAP net profit dropped 47.72% to 436 million yuan, driven by rising supply chain costs and market contraction.

Despite the Q3 slowdown, the company's nine-month performance remained steady. Total revenue for the first three quarters rose 1.49% to 50.28 billion yuan, with net profit expanding 22.44% to 2.63 billion yuan.

Cash flow, however, faced severe pressure, recording a net operating cash outflow of 9.87 billion yuan over the nine-month period. Transsion attributed this to surging memory component prices, aggressive inventory buildup, and higher procurement payments.

title_zh: 火山引擎将商业化列为首要目标，MaaS 上半年收入达 48 亿元
content_zh:
据《晚点 LatePost》10 月 30 日报道，火山引擎的 MaaS（模型即服务）业务上半年收入达到 48 亿元，毛利率超过 55%，是字节跳动当前收入规模最大的 AI 业务。

报道援引知情人士称，火山引擎从年中开始把商业化定为最重要的业务指标，并上调原定 150 亿元的年度收入目标。此前，业务更重视 Token 调用量；企业按使用量付费，而不同模态的模型计费方式各异，调用量与收入并不总是同步增长。

火山引擎既提供 Seed、Seedance 等自研模型，也接入 DeepSeek、智谱等第三方模型。报道称，目前这些模型推理服务均有正毛利；豆包工作还计划面向企业客户接入更多第三方模型，采用订阅费与按量付费结合的方式。
title_en: Volcano Engine Shifts Focus to Commercialization as H1 MaaS Revenue Hits 4.8 Billion Yuan
content_en:
Volcano Engine, ByteDance's cloud division, reported 4.8 billion yuan in revenue from its Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) business during the first half of the year, with a gross margin exceeding 55%. This makes MaaS ByteDance's largest revenue-generating AI line, according to a report by *LatePost* on October 30.

Driven by these results, Volcano Engine made commercialization its top priority in mid-2023 and raised its full-year revenue target from the original 15 billion yuan. Previously, the division focused heavily on token volume. However, because pricing varies across different AI modalities, high usage volume did not always guarantee proportional revenue growth.

In addition to its self-developed models like Seed and Seedance, Volcano Engine integrates third-party models from providers such as DeepSeek and Zhipu AI, all of which are currently operating with positive gross margins. Moving forward, its enterprise platform, Doubao Work, plans to onboard more third-party models under a combined subscription and pay-per-use model.

title_zh: 长鑫第三季度营收突破千亿元，归母净利润环比增长 3.01%
content_zh:
长鑫科技 10 月 30 日披露三季报：第三季度营业收入为 1187.14 亿元，同比增长 613.18%、环比增长 19.30%；归母净利润为 544.35 亿元，同比扭亏、环比增长 3.01%。归母净利润的环比增幅低于营收。

公司称，全球算力需求增长、主要厂商产能调配推动 DRAM 供不应求，加上自身产能建设与产品结构调整，带动产品销量和价格上涨。第三季度毛利率为 89.53%，较上季度提高 1.94 个百分点。

前三季度，公司营业收入为 2690.24 亿元，归母净利润为 1320.40 亿元。同期研发投入 110.71 亿元，同比增长 73.03%；基于第六代技术平台开发的 DRAM 产品已完成工程样片验证。
title_en: ChangXin Technology's Q3 Revenue Surges Past 100 Billion Yuan Amid Strong DRAM Demand
content_en:
ChangXin Technology reported a blockbuster third quarter on October 30, generating 118.71 billion yuan in revenue—a massive 613.18% year-over-year surge and a 19.30% quarter-over-quarter increase. Net profit attributable to the parent company reached 54.44 billion yuan, reversing previous losses and rising 3.01% sequentially, though lagging behind revenue growth.

The company attributed the gains to surging global demand for AI computing capacity and supply adjustments by major manufacturers, which led to a tight DRAM market. Combined with ChangXin's expanding production and product mix optimization, product sales and average selling prices increased significantly. The third-quarter gross margin expanded by 1.94 percentage points sequentially to 89.53%.

Over the first three quarters, revenue reached 269.02 billion yuan, with net profit hitting 132.04 billion yuan. R&D spending jumped 73.03% year-over-year to 11.07 billion yuan, supporting the successful engineering sample validation of DRAM products built on its sixth-generation technology platform.

title_zh: 联发科第三季度营收增长 18.3%，归母净利润增长 10.6%
content_zh:
联发科公布第三季度业绩：收入为 1680.58 亿新台币，同比增长 18.3%、环比增长 10.4%；归属母公司净利润为 278.82 亿新台币，同比增长 10.6%。

公司称，Smart Edge 新项目放量，以及电视系统芯片的 DRAM 含量提高，带动了收入增长。季度毛利率为 46.3%，较上季度提高 0.1 个百分点，较上年同期下降 0.2 个百分点。

期内研发费用为 422.37 亿新台币，占收入 25.1%。
title_en: MediaTek Reports 18.3% Revenue Growth in Q3 Driven by Smart Edge and TV Chips
content_en:
MediaTek reported its third-quarter financial results, posting consolidated revenue of NT$168.06 billion—an 18.3% increase year-over-year and a 10.4% quarter-over-quarter rise. Net profit attributable to the parent company reached NT$27.88 billion, up 10.6% from the same period last year.

The revenue growth was largely driven by the ramp-up of new Smart Edge projects and higher DRAM content integrated into television system-on-chips (SoCs). Gross margin for the quarter came in at 46.3%, edging up 0.1 percentage points from the prior quarter but dipping 0.2 percentage points year-over-year.

MediaTek continued to invest heavily in innovation, allocating NT$42.24 billion to research and development during the quarter, which accounted for 25.1% of its total revenue.

title_zh: 💡 诺奖得主 Acemoglu：AI 应帮助劳动者，别只盯着 AGI
content_zh:
诺贝尔经济学奖得主、MIT 教授 Daron Acemoglu 在彭博最新专访中表示，他此前低估了智能体 AI 的发展速度，但个人生活中使用聊天机器人，与 AI 进入生产流程，仍是两件需要区分的事。

他反对把通用人工智能（AGI）设为唯一发展方向，认为过度执着于这一目标，会让其他用途得不到充分探索。他提出，如果更多 AI 人才能转向提高劳动者生产力、扩大公民自主权等目标，技术就会沿这些方向发展；他也认为，中国比美国更积极地尝试把 AI 融入生产流程。

谈到自动化激励时，Acemoglu 主张缩小资本收入与劳动收入的税收差别，减少企业以资本替代劳动的额外激励。他同时承认，税负变化可能带来企业外迁等现实顾虑，具体政策需要协商。

对于「AI 将改变生活，却应让少数科技企业家决定方向」的主张，他认为，技术的影响越深，公众就越有责任参与塑造其发展。
title_en: Nobel Laureate Daron Acemoglu Urges AI Focus on Empowering Workers Over AGI Pursuit
content_en:
Nobel laureate and MIT professor Daron Acemoglu recently shared his perspectives on artificial intelligence in a Bloomberg interview. While admitting he initially underestimated the rapid rise of AI agents, Acemoglu emphasized the critical distinction between using personal chatbots and integrating AI directly into core production workflows.

Acemoglu warned against treating Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) as the sole goal of AI development, arguing that an overfixation on AGI leaves other beneficial applications unexplored. He advocated redirecting top AI talent toward boosting worker productivity and expanding civic autonomy, noting that China has been noticeably more proactive than the United States in embedding AI into real-world production processes.

Addressing economic incentives, Acemoglu proposed narrowing the tax gap between capital and labor income to deter companies from prematurely replacing human workers with capital investments. He concluded by rejecting the notion that a handful of tech executives should dictate AI's trajectory, stressing that the public must have a voice in shaping technologies that fundamentally alter society.

title_zh: 2027 款奕派 007 上市，限时补贴价 10.99 万元起
content_zh:
2027 款东风奕派 007 在武汉车展上市，推出「550 巡航版」与「675 激光版」，限时补贴价 10.99 万元起。

新车采用后驱平台，车长 4880 毫米、轴距 2915 毫米。675 激光版搭载 73.5 千瓦时电池，CLTC 纯电续航为 675 公里，并配备带激光雷达的天元 T200 辅助驾驶系统。

座舱升级为天元智舱 2.0，采用高通骁龙 8295P 芯片。车辆还提供全温域热泵、半隐藏式机械门把手及电动掀背尾门。
title_en: 2027 Dongfeng eπ 007 Electric Sedan Launches Starting at 109,900 RMB
content_en:
Dongfeng has officially launched the 2027 eπ 007 electric sedan at the Wuhan Auto Show, offering a limited-time subsidized starting price of 109,900 RMB. Built on a rear-wheel-drive platform, the vehicle measures 4,880 mm in length with a 2,915 mm wheelbase, and comes in two primary configurations: the 550 Cruise Edition and the 675 Lidar Edition.

The top-tier 675 Lidar Edition features a 73.5 kWh battery pack delivering a CLTC range of 675 km, along with the Tianyuan T200 advanced driver assistance system powered by LiDAR technology.

Inside, the sedan debuts the upgraded Tianyuan Smart Cockpit 2.0 driven by Qualcomm's flagship Snapdragon 8295P chip. Additional vehicle features include an all-temperature heat pump, semi-flush mechanical door handles, and a power liftback tailgate.

title_zh: Google Antigravity 上线插件市场，接入 Figma、Jira 与生产日志
content_zh:
Google 为 Antigravity App 和 CLI 上线统一插件市场，把外部服务连接、领域操作指引及自动化规则打包安装。首发集成覆盖设计、项目协作、云服务、数据分析和安全等工作场景。

插件可以包含 Skills、MCP 服务配置、规则、Hooks 和自定义智能体，随同一版本一起安装、更新和启停。过去分别配置的接口、环境变量与指令，因而可以作为一个完整组件共享；涉及账号授权的集成会在设置时要求相应认证。

例如，Figma 插件可读取设计上下文并向画布写入内容；Atlassian 集成连接 Jira、Confluence 和 Bitbucket 等工作信息；Datadog 插件则可搜索日志、链路与告警，辅助定位线上故障。用户可从 App 的 Customizations 面板浏览插件，也可通过 CLI 安装。
title_en: Google Launches Antigravity Plugin Marketplace Featuring Figma, Jira, and Datadog Integrations
content_en:
Google has introduced a unified plugin marketplace for the Antigravity App and CLI, enabling developers to seamlessly extend functionality across design, project collaboration, cloud services, analytics, and security. The platform bundles service connectors, domain operational guidelines, skills, MCP configurations, hooks, and custom agents into unified, easy-to-manage packages.

By consolidating previously isolated API keys, environment variables, and instruction scripts, the marketplace simplifies installation, updates, and lifecycle control. Key debut integrations include a Figma plugin for reading and modifying design assets, Atlassian integrations linking Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket, and a Datadog plugin designed to search logs, traces, and alerts for real-time production troubleshooting.

Developers can explore and manage these integrations via the Antigravity App's Customizations panel or directly through the command-line interface.

title_zh: 百度搜索 API 推出活动价：增强版每千次 4.9 元
content_zh:
百度智能云搜索 API 开启限时活动。10 月 30 日至 12 月 31 日，增强版调用包活动价为每千次 4.9 元；旗舰版为每千次 9.9 元，购买需使用邀请码。

服务可检索网页、图片和视频，返回标题、原始链接及内容片段，并提供智能摘要，供智能体或知识库应用接入。

增强版活动包累计购买上限为 100 万次。已购调用包用完后，将自动按对应产品的刊例价计费；调用包有效期以商品详情为准。
title_en: Baidu AI Cloud Cuts Search API Prices to as Low as ¥4.9 per 1,000 Calls
content_en:
Baidu AI Cloud has launched a limited-time promotional campaign for its Search API, running from October 30 through December 31. Under the promotion, the Enhanced edition is priced at ¥4.9 per 1,000 requests, while the Flagship edition costs ¥9.9 per 1,000 requests (invitation code required).

The Search API allows developers to integrate search capabilities across web pages, images, and videos into AI agents or enterprise knowledge bases. It delivers comprehensive query results, including titles, original URLs, content snippets, and AI-generated summaries.

Purchases for the Enhanced promotional package are capped at 1 million calls per user. Once the promotional package is exhausted, standard list pricing will apply.

title_zh: 《哈克小天地》发售，用微缩景观迎接动物居民
content_zh:
Wonderscope Games 开发、Team17 发行的《哈克小天地》（Hokko Spaces）现已在 Steam 发售，支持简体中文。它延续《哈克小镇》的温馨风格，把重点放在小尺度的沙盒造景。

玩家可以布置林间角落、野餐场地与庭院，调整时间、天气和季节，完成轻量目标后解锁动物居民。居民会在场景中散步、打理花园，并与摆放的物品互动。

拍照模式提供滤镜、构图和对焦工具，可将搭好的微缩空间保存成照片。
title_en: Cozy Diorama Sandbox 'Hokko Spaces' Launches on Steam
content_en:
Developer Wonderscope Games and publisher Team17 have officially released *Hokko Spaces* on Steam, complete with Simplified Chinese support. Building on the charming aesthetic of *Hokko Life*, this cozy new entry focuses on micro-scale sandbox diorama building.

Players can design and customize intimate spaces—such as forest nooks, picnic grounds, and quiet courtyards—while tweaking time, weather, and seasonal settings. Completing light objectives unlocks cute animal residents who walk around, tend to gardens, and interact with decorated items.

The game also features a robust Photo Mode equipped with filters, composition tools, and focus controls, allowing players to capture and save high-quality snapshots of their detailed creations.

title_zh: 清华等团队让 96 台机器人共享经验，手机包装成功率升至 98.3%
content_zh:
清华大学、智元机器人及无问芯穹提出群体经验学习（CEL）方案，让机器人将部署中完成任务的经验汇总起来，改进共同使用的策略。

在专家完成初始指导后，系统利用失败前的场景，检索其他机器人做成功的相似片段，再用于微调。后续学习不再需要新增专家示范或纠错动作；人类仍负责结果标注及环境复位。

团队在插花、叠衣、手机充电、凳子组装及手机包装五项任务上测试。手机包装实验使用 96 台机器人采集经验，另在两台未参与采集的同型号机器人上完成 120 次评估，成功率由 79.2% 升至 98.3%。
title_en: Tsinghua Team Boosts Robot Packaging Success Rate to 98.3% via Swarm Learning
content_en:
Researchers from Tsinghua University, Agibot, and Infinence have introduced Collective Experience Learning (CEL), a framework that enables multiple robots to aggregate task experience and refine a shared operational policy.

Following initial expert guidance, the system automatically retrieves successful execution snippets from peer robots whenever a failure occurs, using those clips to fine-tune the master model. This eliminates the need for ongoing human demonstration or real-time teleoperated corrections, leaving humans responsible only for output labeling and environment resets.

The CEL framework was evaluated across five tasks, including flower arranging, clothes folding, phone charging, stool assembly, and phone packaging. In the packaging experiment, data collected from 96 robots enabled two unseen test units to boost their task success rate from 79.2% to 98.3% across 120 trials.

title_zh: 智元发布 GO-3 Preview，以统一框架连接推理、预测与动作
content_zh:
智元在 10 月 29 日的创新日发布具身基础模型 GO-3 Preview，采用 WRAM 框架，将推理、环境预测和动作执行连接起来。

公司展示了零样本和少样本任务能力，希望机器人在执行前预测动作结果，并在环境变化时调整，而非只复现固定流程。其训练路线覆盖预训练、后训练，以及部署后的持续改进。

据智元现场公布的评测，GO-3 Preview 在 RoboDojo 的任务成功率和过程评分、RoboTwin 及 RoboColiseum 的综合评分上取得第一名。
title_en: Agibot Unveils GO-3 Preview Embodied Model to Unify Reasoning, Prediction, and Action
content_en:
On October 29 during its Innovation Day, robotics startup Agibot officially unveiled GO-3 Preview, a new embodied foundation model powered by the World Reasoning Action Model (WRAM) framework. The model unifies reasoning, environmental prediction, and action execution into a single cohesive system.

Designed to move beyond fixed execution scripts, GO-3 Preview demonstrates zero-shot and few-shot capabilities. It allows robots to forecast the outcomes of their actions prior to execution and dynamically adapt when their surroundings change. The model’s training pipeline spans pre-training, post-training, and continuous post-deployment optimization.

According to evaluation metrics shared at the event, GO-3 Preview achieved top rankings across several benchmarks, placing first in task success rate and procedural scoring on RoboDojo, as well as securing the highest overall scores on RoboTwin and RoboColiseum.

title_zh: 小米推出 8 亿参数 OCR 模型，打通文档解析、抽取与问答
content_zh:
小米技术 10 月 30 日推出文档理解模型 Xiaomi-OCR-0，用 8 亿参数统一文档解析、关键信息抽取与视觉问答。模型可把正文、表格和公式转成 Markdown、LaTeX，按指定字段提取票据、卡证信息并输出 JSON，也能围绕图表内容回答问题。

在官方公布的两阶段文档解析评测中，模型在模拟扫描、纸张弯曲、屏幕翻拍等干扰的 Real5-OmniDocBench 上取得 95.24 分，在页面列出的模型比较中排名第一；OmniDocBench v1.6 得分为 96.83。

小米称，相关技术正用于超级小爱的取餐码识别、账单记账、日程创建等场景。模型权重、推理代码、浏览器 Demo、MCP 服务和 Agent Skill 工具包已开放，开发者可以接入自己的文档处理流程。
title_en: Xiaomi Releases 800M-Parameter Xiaomi-OCR-0 Model for Advanced Document Parsing and Extraction
content_en:
Xiaomi Technology introduced Xiaomi-OCR-0 on October 30, an 800-million-parameter document understanding model that unifies document parsing, key information extraction, and visual question answering (VQA). The model converts body text, tables, and mathematical formulas into Markdown and LaTeX, extracts specified fields from receipts and identification cards into structured JSON format, and answers queries regarding chart content.

In official evaluations targeting complex real-world conditions—such as scanned documents, curved paper, and screen photographs—Xiaomi-OCR-0 achieved top-tier performance. It scored 95.24 on the Real5-OmniDocBench benchmark, outperforming other listed models, and recorded a score of 96.83 on OmniDocBench v1.6.

The technology is currently integrated into Xiaomi’s XiaoAI assistant for features like food pick-up code recognition, expense tracking, and schedule creation. Xiaomi has open-sourced the model weights, inference code, browser demo, Model Context Protocol (MCP) service, and Agent Skill toolkit for developer integration.

title_zh: hololive 推出服装品牌 holoSynQ，首系列围绕 FLOW GLOW 展开
content_zh:
VTuber 企业 COVER 与日本纺织商社 MN Inter-Fashion 合作推出服装品牌「hololive – holoSynQ」，首个系列以旗下组合 FLOW GLOW 为主题，将角色元素融入日常街头服饰。

COVER 负责品牌概念与设计方向，MN Inter-Fashion 负责面料、服装制作及品质管理。首波设计使用中性版型，包含运动外套、连帽上衣和可搭配布章的卫衣；官网还展示了长裤、图案 T 恤、帽子和包袋等单品，部分设计通过刺绣和发泡印刷呈现图案。

品牌官网于 10 月 30 日上线。首波商品计划在 11 月 6 日至 2027 年 1 月 14 日，于东京东急 Plaza 表参道 OMOKADO 的 KIDDY LAND 4 楼快闪店率先销售，地点邻近 hololive 原宿官方商店。
title_en: COVER Partners with MN Inter-Fashion to Launch Apparel Brand "hololive – holoSynQ"
content_en:
VTuber agency COVER Corporation has partnered with Japanese textile trading firm MN Inter-Fashion to launch "hololive – holoSynQ," an apparel brand that blends virtual character motifs into everyday streetwear. The debut collection centers on hololive's VTuber group FLOW GLOW.

Under the partnership, COVER oversees brand concept and design strategy, while MN Inter-Fashion handles fabric sourcing, garment manufacturing, and quality control. The initial lineup features gender-neutral silhouettes including track jackets, hoodies, and sweatshirts designed for customizable patch attachments. Additional items showcased on the brand's website include trousers, graphic T-shirts, caps, and bags, utilizing techniques such as embroidery and puff printing.

Following the launch of its official website on October 30, the first collection will debut at a pop-up store located on the 4th floor of KIDDY LAND in Tokyu Plaza Omotesando OMOKADO, Tokyo. The store will operate from November 6 through January 14, 2027, situated near the official hololive Harajuku shop.

title_zh: 日本松屋会员数据遭入侵，涉及逾 237 万条记录
content_zh:
日本餐饮连锁松屋披露，会员系统遭未授权访问，涉及约 237.7 万条会员记录，可能包含会员编号、姓名、地址、电话号码及积分信息。

据 Impress Watch 原始报道，另一部分约 2000 条、最多可能约 3000 条记录还涉及出生日期、电子邮箱和加密密码。公司称，系统没有保存信用卡信息。

松屋于 10 月 28 日发现异常，随后展开调查，并向个人信息保护委员会报告，计划联系受影响会员。
title_en: Matsuya Data Breach Exposes Over 2.37 Million Member Records in Japan
content_en:
Japanese fast-food chain Matsuya Foods has disclosed a major security breach, revealing unauthorized access to its customer loyalty system affecting approximately 2.377 million member records. The compromised data includes member IDs, names, physical addresses, phone numbers, and loyalty point details.

According to local reports, a smaller subset of up to 3,000 records also exposed dates of birth, email addresses, and encrypted passwords. Matsuya confirmed that no credit card information was compromised, as payment details are not stored on the affected system.

The anomaly was first detected on October 28. Matsuya has since launched an internal investigation, reported the incident to Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission, and announced plans to individually notify affected customers.

title_zh: One Fun Thing｜合上 iPhone Duo，烤一份虚拟芝士吐司
content_zh:
Toastie 把折叠手机变成了烤吐司机。先选面包，再铺上黄油、芝士和其他配料，合上 iPhone Duo，就开始加热；重新展开时，吐司也到了出炉时刻。

开得太早会夹生，放得太久则会烤焦。游戏会结合配方、摆盘、烘烤程度和准备时间评分，制作过程也包含真实等待的节奏。

应用由 Tomasz Szykulski 开发。其他 iPhone 和 iPad 可以操作虚拟烤盘盖，Duo 则将合盖动作直接交给手机铰链。
title_en: 'Toastie' App Turns Foldable Smartphones Into Virtual Sandwich Presses
content_en:
Developer Tomasz Szykulski has launched *Toastie*, a playful mobile app that turns foldable smartphones into virtual toaster presses. Players can assemble customized sandwiches by selecting bread, butter, cheese, and various toppings, then physically closing their foldable device to initiate the cooking process.

Timing is critical to gameplay: unfolding the phone too early results in undercooked toast, while waiting too long burns it. Each creation is scored based on the recipe, presentation, degree of baking, and preparation time, incorporating realistic waiting periods.

While standard iPhones and iPads rely on an on-screen virtual lid, the app uniquely leverages the physical hinge mechanism of foldable devices like the conceptual "iPhone Duo" to trigger the baking process when folded shut.

title_zh: 周末看什么｜《艾泽拉斯星球》把鱼人和狗头人拍成自然纪录片
content_zh:
英国喜剧演员兼音乐人 Bill Bailey 化身矮人探险家，走进《魔兽世界》的生态环境。《艾泽拉斯星球》（Planet Azeroth）借用自然纪录片的讲述方式，把鱼人、狗头人等游戏生物变成观察对象，由 Bailey 配音介绍它们的生活。

系列共计划三集，将穿过艾尔文森林、冬泉谷等地区。首集已上线 World of Warcraft 官方 YouTube 频道，时长 6 分 47 秒，官方简介列出的主角包括鱼人和狗头人。

TechRadar 的评论将其描述为一部「纪录片失控」式伪纪录片，并认为它可以为《World of Warcraft: Forever》预热，同时保留对新作的观望。Bailey 则在公开介绍中说，自己一直着迷于自然世界，这次探索艾泽拉斯时终于不用担心被咬或弄湿衣服。
title_en: 'Planet Azeroth': World of Warcraft Parodies Nature Documentaries with Bill Bailey
content_en:
Blizzard Entertainment has released *Planet Azeroth*, a three-part mini-series that reimagines the wildlife of *World of Warcraft* through the lens of a classic BBC-style nature documentary. British comedian and musician Bill Bailey voices a dwarf explorer investigating the daily lives of infamous game creatures like Murlocs and Kobolds.

The first episode, running 6 minutes and 47 seconds, is now available on the official *World of Warcraft* YouTube channel. The series follows the narrator through iconic locations such as Elwynn Forest and Winterspring, blending gaming lore with traditional documentary storytelling.

Critics have praised the mockumentary for its clever execution and humorous tone. Bailey expressed excitement about the project, joking that exploring Azeroth allows him to indulge his passion for nature without the real-world risk of getting bitten or wet.

title_zh: 买书不读指南｜《群鸟》从秋日乡野写到无法解释的恐怖
content_zh:
达芙妮·杜穆里埃的《群鸟》（The Birds）从英国康沃尔的秋日乡野出发，让熟悉的自然环境逐渐变成威胁。这个故事后来被希区柯克改编成同名电影；原著以写实细节累积恐惧，而非为鸟群的行为给出清楚的解释。

Hachette 旗下 Virago 推出的英文电子版可作为免费试读获取，发行于 2025 年 8 月 11 日，ISBN 为 9780349021096。它也是杜穆里埃短篇合集《After Midnight》的试读篇目，合集配有斯蒂芬·金新写的导言。

出版社收录的《卫报》评论认为，故事从近乎田园式的康沃尔场景，逐步进入难以理解的恐怖；作家 Sarah Waters 则把这批短篇描述为自然失常、日常与诡异边界模糊的故事。
title_en: Daphne du Maurier’s 'The Birds': From Idyllic Countryside to Unexplained Horror
content_en:
Daphne du Maurier’s classic short story *The Birds* opens in the quiet autumnal countryside of Cornwall, slowly turning a familiar natural environment into a lingering threat. While famously adapted into a film by Alfred Hitchcock, the original text builds dread through realistic everyday details rather than providing explicit explanations for the avian menace.

A free English ebook sample was released by Hachette's Virago imprint on August 11, 2025 (ISBN: 9780349021096). It offers a preview of du Maurier’s short story collection *After Midnight*, which features a new introduction by Stephen King.

Reviews highlighted by the publisher praise the story’s gradual descent from pastoral tranquility into incomprehensible terror. Author Sarah Waters similarly described the collection as a masterclass in nature going awry, skillfully blurring the boundary between the ordinary and the uncanny.

title_zh: 游戏推荐｜《无人深空》在星际送快递，也能直接飞向邻近恒星
content_zh:
Hello Games 的《无人深空》让玩家在程序生成的宇宙中探索星球、采集资源、升级飞船并建造基地。每颗星球有自己的地貌和生命，玩家可以独自远行，也可以与其他玩家分享发现、合作建设。Steam 简体中文商店页目前的近期评测和简体中文评测均为「特别好评」。

新上线的 Forsaken 7.10 更新增加了太空快递任务：拥有轻型护卫舰和引力线圈的玩家，可从深空前哨接取包裹运送委托。飞行途中，邻近星系的恒星也能直接选中并跃迁，无需先打开银河地图；废弃货船、感染前哨与深空残骸中则能收集奇异纪念物，换取生物机械风格的舰船模块。

完整游戏现已登陆 iOS，界面针对触控重新设计，官方称移动版针对电池续航和发热作了优化。PC 版由 Hello Games 开发并发行，Steam 页面记录的发行日期为 2016 年 8 月 13 日。
title_en: No Man’s Sky Update Introduces Space Deliveries and Direct Star Warping
content_en:
Hello Games’ procedurally generated space exploration title, *No Man’s Sky*, allows players to survey unique planets, gather resources, upgrade starships, and construct bases either solo or cooperatively. The game currently maintains a "Very Positive" rating on Steam.

The newly released *Forsaken* 7.10 update introduces interstellar delivery missions. Players equipped with light frigates and gravity coils can accept parcel delivery contracts from deep-space outposts. System navigation has also been streamlined, allowing pilots to target and warp directly to neighboring stars without opening the galaxy map. Furthermore, salvaging derelict freighters, infected outposts, and space debris yields exotic souvenirs that can be exchanged for biomechanical ship modules.

Beyond PC—where the game originally debuted on August 13, 2016—the full *No Man’s Sky* experience is now available on iOS. The mobile edition features a redesigned touch interface along with technical optimizations for battery life and thermal management.
